test_title: PYST 28: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

A great / culture of hospitality of / the Spanish / is well-known.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the awkward phrasing and wordiness of** "culture of hospitality of."**
 
• It would be more concise and grammatically correct to use** "hospitality culture of."**
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**A great hospitality culture of the Spanish is well-known."***

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the Spanish"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and refers to the people of Spain.
 
• **Option 2: "is well-known."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 4: "A great"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
